name: High-VIX days: fade stretches away from VWAP
why: In high-volatility regimes intraday moves are driven by de-risking flows that overshoot; dealers long gamma are paid to absorb them and pin price back toward the day's average. In calm regimes the same stretch is information and keeps going (vwap_fade fails on all days).

scan.when: vix >= v && vsd > 0 && abs(cl(5,1) - vwap) > b*vsd
